messages.body:
Hi! I run partnerships at Nightjar Games. We're launching Hollow Pines on October 24 and would love to sponsor a stream that week, ideally a first playthrough.

We can send keys for you and two crew members. What are your rates, and do you have a media kit?
Loved the run, but during the basement chase the game audio was so loud I couldn't hear you at all. Maybe duck the game a bit when you talk?
@ravenmod timed me out for 10 minutes right when the raid came in. I was only spamming the emote everyone else was. It felt personal.
Your scream at the end of the doll clip had me crying laughing. Just wanted to say hi, I'll be at the next stream!
Every time I press Continue with Twitch it asks me to authorize and then drops me back on the sign-in box. Chrome on Windows.

notes.text: Asked them to try with cookies allowed for boomertanger.com. Waiting to hear.

messages.body: I've watched since your first stream. Your streams got me through a really rough year, and I didn't want to post that in chat. Thank you.
We're doing a feature on horror streamers for our Halloween issue and would love 15 minutes with you this week.

notes.text: Happy to! Thursday or Friday afternoon works.

messages.body: @grimjaw keeps sending me DMs on Discord after streams even though I asked them to stop.
Thanks for the shoutout last night, made my week.
The schedule takes ages to show on my phone (iPhone 12).
Dear Website Owner, we can get your site to #1 on Google in 7 days...
